summary: Integrate ESG into digital products, AI, cloud and supplier decisions. Build impact measures and a roadmap. Explore the course.
lede: ESG integration in digital transformation helps digital, sustainability and product leaders include environmental and social criteria in portfolio decisions. Participants practise mapping material impacts, estimating digital emissions, assessing AI use cases and screening technology suppliers with reference to GRI Standards, the GHG Protocol and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework. They also develop portfolio indicators and a practical roadmap for prioritizing initiatives and explaining their impacts to decision-makers.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who shape digital investments and need to make ESG considerations visible in product, technology and transformation decisions.
prerequisites: Prior work exposure to digital transformation, sustainability or ESG decision-making will help you apply the exercises. No coding is required; spreadsheet familiarity is useful for the emissions calculation.
